data.summary: Beispiel Ersatzkasse rejects Lina Mustermeier's application of 10 June 2025 for reimbursement of taxi costs to outpatient physiotherapy, stating that the legal conditions under § 60 SGB V (e.g. care level 3 with permanently limited mobility, or marks aG/Bl/H) are not met.
data.explanation: Your health insurer has turned down your request to have taxi costs for outpatient physiotherapy covered, because you do not meet the strict conditions the law sets for this (§ 60 SGB V). If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch), in writing or for the record at Beispiel Ersatzkasse, and the app will show you the deadline. If you do not object by the deadline shown, the rejection becomes final. Otherwise, if you think you may qualify (e.g. through a care level or disability mark), you could ask your doctor or a social advice service for support before deciding.
